issues.title: Gmail image attachment OCR
issues.description:
## Summary
Add OCR support for image attachments in `read_attachment`.

## Problem
Today `read_attachment` supports text MIME types and PDF only.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `SecurityPolicy.isGmailReadableAttachment()` recognizes common image MIME types
- [ ] `GmailService.readAttachment()` extracts text from images via Vision/OCR
- [ ] Fetch report indicates OCR completeness
- [ ] Unit tests for MIME detection and OCR path
- [ ] Documented in `reference/gmail-setup.md`

## Code references
- `GmailService.swift`, `SecurityPolicy.swift`, `GmailTool.swift`

issues.title: Gmail OAuth macOS verification
issues.description:
## Summary
End-to-end verification of Gmail OAuth on macOS.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Fresh Connect Gmail flow succeeds
- [ ] Token refresh works after access token expiry
- [ ] Disconnect clears tokens and UI state
- [ ] Agent can get_status, list, search, read, and send

## Code references
- `GmailAuthManager.swift`, `reference/gmail-setup.md`

issues.title: Expand Gmail test coverage
issues.description:
## Summary
Add unit tests beyond parsing — fetch report formatting, auditor logic, action permission matrix.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Tests for `GmailReadAuditor.auditAssistantResponse()` edge cases
- [ ] Tests for `SecurityPolicy.isGmailActionPermitted()` local vs iMessage
- [ ] Tests for fetch report `fetch_complete` flag logic
- [ ] All tests pass via ⌘U in Xcode

issues.title: Gmail Pub/Sub push notifications
issues.description:
## Summary
Replace polling-only inbox sync with Gmail Pub/Sub push notifications.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Design doc for Pub/Sub topic, subscription, and HTTPS webhook endpoint
- [ ] New mail triggers snapshot refresh without manual action
- [ ] Graceful fallback to periodic refresh if push unavailable
- [ ] Document setup requirements (public HTTPS endpoint)

issues.title: Remove or register dead `replace_file_content` tool
issues.description:
## Summary
`ReplaceFileContentTool` exists in `FileTools.swift` but is not registered in `WorkspaceManager.localTools`. It duplicates `patch`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Either register `replace_file_content` in local tools, OR remove `ReplaceFileContentTool`

issues.title: Expand test coverage beyond Gmail
